hooks.command: bash -c 'candidate="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; root="$(git -C "$candidate" rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree 2>/dev/null)"; [ -n "$root" ] || root="$(git -C "$candidate" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; [ -n "$root" ] || root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; cd "$root" && exec bash "$root/hooks/scripts/docs-reminder.sh"'
